description: Sidewinder TEAM + SKILL edition pack for residential HVAC. Skill layer: diagnose-first troubleshooting of furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, and duct systems plus career development — mentoring, diagnostics discipline, seasonal readiness systems, profitable service calls, callback prevention, kit building, building-science reading, and the helper-to-lead career ladder. Team layer: crew plays for coordinated installs, two-tech radio protocol, weekly skill swaps, heat-wave surge triage, and graduated apprentice responsibility. Improvised tools and explicit stop conditions at the licensed-tech, gas-safety, and electrical-safety lines. Lawful DIY only; refrigerant handling is licensed-technician-only by law.
name: HVAC
notes_for_main_builder: Draft manifest for the editions framework to validate. Prerequisite graph is internal to this pack (sw-home-hvac-* ids only). Titles were hand-deduped. Ids normalized by coordinator to the framework law (curriculum/schema.py); full file validates clean.
safety_posture: Refrigerant handling is licensed-technician-only by law: entries diagnose up to that line and stop there.
Any gas smell: stop, evacuate, call the gas company from outside.
Electrical compartments are de-energized and verified before touching.
Capacitors are diagnose-only: never touch terminals.

track_emphasis.build: secondary - window-unit install, filter fabrication, evaporative-cooler startup
track_emphasis.create: secondary - thermostat relocation, duct reroute design
track_emphasis.improve: primary - airflow, sealing, balancing, and efficiency upgrades
track_emphasis.improvise: primary - airflow-first diagnosis without gauges, improvised dampers, cut-to-fit filters, improvised manometer
track_emphasis.restore: primary - diagnosis and repair of furnaces, AC, heat pumps, blowers, drains, and ducts
